# Art of Mentoring

> A global mentoring platform trusted in 26 countries that helps organizations build cultures of growth through structured mentoring programs, advanced matching algorithms, and comprehensive training.

Art of Mentoring provides ISO 27001-certified mentoring solutions for diverse organizational needs including leadership development, DEI initiatives, talent retention, and professional growth. The platform serves corporations, associations, and government entities with customizable mentoring programs supported by workshops and training for mentors, mentees, and program managers.

## Key Topics

- Mentoring Platform
- NEAR Framework
- Leadership Development
- Talent Development
- Organizational Growth
- DEI (Diversity, Equity, Inclusion)
- Mentor Matching Algorithm
- ISO 27001 Certified
- Engagement Tracking
- Succession Planning
- Mentor Training
- Mentee Training
- Program Management
- Women's Leadership
- Professional Development

## Platform & Core Offerings

- [Mentoring Platform](https://artofmentoring.net/about-mentoring/mentoring-platform): ISO 27001-certified platform with matching algorithm and engagement tracking
- [About Mentoring](https://artofmentoring.net/about-mentoring): Overview of mentoring framework and NEAR model for organizational growth
- [Mentoring Programs](https://artofmentoring.net/mentoring-programs): ISO-certified mentoring platform with mentor matching and analytics features

## Mentoring Programs by Audience

- [Organisations](https://artofmentoring.net/audiences/organisations): Corporate, association, and government mentoring programs for organizations
- [Leadership Development](https://artofmentoring.net/audiences/leadership-development): Leadership development mentoring with succession planning and capability building
- [Mentoring for Women](https://artofmentoring.net/audiences/mentoring-for-women): Structured mentoring programs for women's leadership and gender equity
- [Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI)](https://artofmentoring.net/audiences/diversity-equity-and-inclusion-dei): DEI-focused mentoring programs for inclusive leadership and representation
- [Professional Development](https://artofmentoring.net/audiences/professional-development): Professional development mentoring for organizational learning and growth
- [Early Career Talent](https://artofmentoring.net/audiences/early-career-talent): Mentoring programs for early-career talent, graduates, and onboarding
- [Audiences Overview](https://artofmentoring.net/audiences): Mentoring program segments for diverse organizational audiences and use cases

## Training & Workshops

- [Trainings & Workshops](https://artofmentoring.net/trainings-and-workshops): Training and workshop offerings for mentors, mentees, and program managers
- [Workshops for Mentors](https://artofmentoring.net/training-workshops/workshops-for-mentors): Mentor training workshops on mentorship skills and goal-setting techniques
- [Workshops for Mentees](https://artofmentoring.net/training-workshops/workshops-for-mentees): Interactive workshops for mentees covering goal-setting and skill development
- [Workshops for Program Managers](https://artofmentoring.net/training-workshops/workshops-for-program-managers): Program manager training using 7-step model for mentoring program success
- [Online Training for Mentors](https://artofmentoring.net/training-workshops/online-training-for-mentors): Online training for mentors on mentoring programs and organizational growth
- [Online Training for Mentees](https://artofmentoring.net/training-workshops/online-training-for-mentees): Online training for mentees on talent development and mentoring programs
